finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If T is a class with a non-trivial destructor that executes external commands based on its content, an attacker could inject malicious commands.
finding.assumptions: The type T might have a non-trivial destructor that executes external commands based on its content.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If T is a class that executes external commands based on its content when assigned, an attacker could inject malicious commands.
finding.assumptions: The type T might have an assignment operator that executes external commands based on its content.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If T is a class that executes external commands based on its content when returned, an attacker could inject malicious commands.
finding.assumptions: The type T might have a copy constructor or copy assignment operator that executes external commands based on its content.
